import json, os, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/dev')
from perf import gen_stream_big, gen_burst_big, make_borders

PROG = '/app/submission/scheduler.py'
path = sys.argv[1]
data = open(path, 'rb').read()
t0 = time.time()
with open('/dev/null', 'wb') as sink:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', PROG], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stdout=sink, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, input=data)
t1 = time.time()
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('in=%.2fMiB rc=%d wall=%.2fs peakRSS=%dMiB stderr=%s' %
      (len(data) / 1048576, p.returncode, t1 - t0, ru.ru_maxrss // 1024, p.stderr[:300]))
